reason: B is the better proposal because coherent interfaces enabling dislocation transmission and reducing crack-tip stress concentration have direct precedent in tungsten refractory HEAs, whereas A extrapolates cryogenic FCC nanotwinning evidence to a high-temperature BCC alloy, where twinning is generally less plausible. B remains incomplete because it assumes nanoprecipitates in equimolar WTaTiVZr and compares only against tungsten rather than using a solutionized-versus-precipitated HEA control to isolate their effect.
